name: AVA Infrastructure Fund
source: AVA Infrastructure Fund audited annual report for the year ended 31 December 2024 (NGX corporate disclosure). Statement of comprehensive income, printed page 21; statement of financial position, printed page 22; statement of cash flows, printed page 24. The fund was listed on the NGX main board on 10 May 2024 and raised 4.075 billion naira in its first series, so 2024 is its first reporting year and the statements print a single column.
unit: NGN, printed in thousands of naira and converted to naira. The filing's own rounding: the printed Total income line is 799,087 thousand naira while the two printed components, interest income 798,605 and other income 483, sum to 799,088, and net cash flow from operating, investing and financing activities sums to 4,312,239 against the printed net increase of 4,312,238. The printed lines are carried.
